name: exchange_theorem
summary: The equal-rank constant (`exists_equalRankThetaRatio_value`) and the exchange with implicit constant (`exchange_of_partners`) give the constant C₀/C; for tame (𝔪, ν, χ), make the split tame character 𝔠 with places those of 𝔪, read the identity for it, and transport partners and data from O_E/𝔪 to the local product at S by pulling them back along the surjective ring map π : O_S → O_E/𝔪 through which the reduction factors (entry by entry on integral matrices, 0 elsewhere).

steps.claim: Not a step of the proof: lines 19–21 are the rest of the statement, which ends before the `:=` on line 21 (a second-reader message). The line census takes the `:=` of `let γ :=` on line 19 for the start of the value, so the check requires these lines to be owned here. They state: γ = rankTwist(ν⁻¹, n); there is c ≠ 0 with |c|² = C·lValueProd(places(𝔪), ν, e) (= C·(∏_{w∈S} Nw)^{e²}·∏_{j=1}^{e}|L^{S∪S̄}(j, BC ν)|², S = places(𝔪)) such that for all Φ, Ψ with IsPartner(⊤, σ, χ, Φ, Ψ) and every g: thetaIntegral(W, V, γ, 1, modDatum(W, V, 𝔪, Φ, x))(g) = c·∫ pairTheta(V′, W, γ, γ, modDatum(V′, W, 𝔪, Ψ, v), (h, g)) dh over [U(V′)].
steps.lean:
IsTameFor 𝔪 ν μ χ → let γ := rankTwist ν⁻¹ n; ∃ c ≠ 0, ‖c‖ ^ 2 = C * lValueProd 𝔪.places ν e
    ∧ ∀ Φ Ψ, IsPartner ⊤ σ χ Φ Ψ → ∀ g, thetaIntegral W V γ 1 (modDatum W V 𝔪 Φ x) g =
    c * ∫ h, pairTheta V' W γ γ (modDatum _ W 𝔪 Ψ v) (h, g) ∂V'.quotMeasure := by

steps.claim: The equal-rank value for W (`exists_equalRankThetaRatio_value` with k = |n|/2 − negCount(s)): a rapid r₀ and C₀ ≠ 0 with equalRankThetaRatio(hypSum(Unit, W), 𝔠, r₀) = C₀ for every 𝔠 (its two hypotheses are proved at the end).
steps.lean: have ⟨_, r₀, C₀, _⟩ := exists_equalRankThetaRatio_value W μ (card n / 2 - negCount s) ?_ ?_

steps.claim: The exchange with implicit constant (`exchange_of_partners`) for (V′, W, V) and the splitting removePlanes(W) of hypSum(Unit, W) over W: C, a rapid x (r) and, for every 𝔠, constants with C|c|² = Π(|a| − |n|/2)·equalRankThetaRatio and the identity on partners (H).
steps.lean: have ⟨C, x, r, H⟩ := exchange_of_partners V' μ (removePlanes _ W) V σ r₀ hv ?_ ?_

steps.claim: Take the constant C₀/C and x; let 𝔪, ν, χ be tame: 𝔪 has places (h), ν has weight μ with tame part ψ (a₁), ψ is non-trivial exactly at the places of 𝔪 (a₂), χ is the character of the tame part (a₃).
steps.lean: use C₀ / C, x, r, fun 𝔪 ν χ ⟨h, ψ, a₁, a₂, a₃⟩ ↦ ?_

steps.claim: The set of places of 𝔪, as a finite set (o).

Let 𝔠 = (ν, ψ, S = the places of 𝔪) as a split tame character: S non-empty (h), disjoint from its conjugate (`Modulus.not_le_star`), ψ non-trivial exactly on S (a₂); the positivity of the weights is left open.
steps.lean: let 𝔠 := SplitTameChar.mk ν ψ a₁ _ (by simpa using! h) (by simpa using! 𝔪.not_le_star) (o ▸ a₂) ?_

steps.claim: For 𝔠: c with the norm relation hc and the identity H (step 3); Π(e) > 0 (`lValueProdInt_pos`); and the reading of the components at S (the maps m, ρ, k, k′).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨c, hc, H⟩, l, _, m, _, ρ, _, k, k'⟩ := H 𝔠, lValueProdInt_pos 𝔠 e, o ▸ 𝔠.readsAt

steps.claim: In hc, |a| − |n|/2 = e, since |n| = |b| + |a| = 2|b| + 2e (σ and he).
steps.lean: simp +arith [*, ← card_congr σ, Int.add_mul_ediv_left] at hc

steps.claim: Take c: c ≠ 0 (otherwise the positive Π(e)·C₀ would vanish), and |c|² = (C₀/C)·lValueProd(places(𝔪), ν, e) by hc and step 2; fix partners Φ, Ψ (P).
steps.lean: use c, by grind [norm_zero], by grind, fun Φ Ψ P ↦ ?_

steps.claim: Let π : O_S → O_E/𝔪 be the surjective ring homomorphism from the integral ring O_S of the local product at S (the image of the integral adeles under evalPlaces) to the modulus ring, through which the reduction 𝔪.reduction factors: π(evalPlaces(u)) = reduction(u) (`RingHom.liftOfRightInverse` of the restricted evalPlaces, whose kernel lies in that of the reduction; the right inverse of evalPlaces built from the reading maps m, ρ, k is auxiliary). π goes from the local product to O_E/𝔪, not the other way.
steps.lean:
let π := ((evalPlaces 𝔠.S).restrict _ _ evalPlaces_mem_O).liftOfRightInverse
    (⟨_, by simpa [← k', *] using m <| ρ ·⟩) (Subtype.ext <| k ·) ⟨𝔪.reduction, fun x hx ↦
    (𝔪.reduction_congr (y := 0) (congr($hx.1 ⟨·, o.ge ·⟩))).trans (map_zero _)⟩

steps.claim: π is compatible with the residues at every place i of S (`Modulus.modulusResidue_reduction`).
steps.lean:
have e i u : modulusResidue _ (o.le i.2) (π u) = residueAt i u :=
    (modulusResidue_reduction ..).trans congr(⟦⟨$(k u) i, _⟩⟧)
steps.typed_fact: modulusResidue _ (o.le i.2) (π u) = residueAt i u

steps.claim: For index types n, n′ and a function Φ on matrices mod 𝔪: the adelic lift 𝔪.liftFn(Φ) equals liftIntegralFn(π, Φ) evaluated at the components at S: the pull-back of Φ along π, entry by entry, on the integral matrices over O_S, extended by 0 off the integral locus (`liftFn_apply`).
steps.lean:
have d {n n' : Type} [Fintype n] [Fintype n'] Φ : 𝔪.liftFn (Φ ∘ @vecToMat n n' _) =
    (liftIntegralFn π Φ <| vecToMat <| evalPlaces
    _ ∘ ·) := by ext; erw [liftFn_apply, mk'_apply]; congr! <;> simp [vecToMat, m, ← k']; rfl
steps.typed_fact:
𝔪.liftFn (Φ ∘ @vecToMat n n' _) =
    (liftIntegralFn π Φ <| vecToMat <| evalPlaces
    _ ∘ ·)

steps.claim: Apply H to the lifts of Φ and Ψ: the lift of Ψ is locally constant (`isSchwartzBruhat_liftFn`), and the lifts are partners over O (`IsPartner.lift_of_reduction`, which needs π : O_S → O_E/𝔪 in this direction: π is a local homomorphism, an element whose image is a unit having non-zero residues and so being a unit (step 12); π is surjective, as the reduction is; and the local character of 𝔠 is χ∘π on units, by a₃ and step 12); by step 13 the modDatum's are the local data of H.
steps.lean:
simpa [modDatum, 𝔠, *] using! H _ _ (by simpa [Function.comp_def, *] using (d Ψ ▸
    isSchwartzBruhat_liftFn .. :).locally_constant.comp_continuous (f := (ρ ∘ matToVec ·)) (by
    fun_prop [matToVec])) (P.lift_of_reduction π ⟨fun u h ↦ isUnit_iff_residueAt_ne_zero.2
    (e · u ▸ (h.map _).ne_zero)⟩ (𝔪.reduction_surjective.forall.2 fun _ ↦
    ⟨_, liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply ..⟩) (by
    simp_intro .. [← finprod_comp_equiv (Set.equivOfEq o),
    a₃, charOfTamePart, ← e, 𝔠.localChar_apply_of_isUnit, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype]; rfl))

steps.claim: The remaining hypotheses (of steps 2 and 3, and the positive weights of 𝔠) hold by arithmetic with |n| = |a| + |b|.
